usage: nightshift build [-h] [--cwd CWD] [--cmd CMD] [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                        [--cancel]
                        shift [n]

Run a heavy build or test suite in a folder, one at a time across shifts:
waits while another live build holds the folder (exit 6 after --timeout), then
runs COMMAND and records <state_dir>/builds/<n>.json (head, dirty tree, exit,
log) as evidence; exit code = COMMAND's. --cancel SHIFT N kills build N's
process tree and marks it cancelled.

positional arguments:
  shift              shift name, unique suffix, or "latest"
  n                  with --cancel: the build number

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --cwd CWD          folder to build in (its build lock serialises builds
                     there)
  --cmd CMD          the command line to run (through the shell)
  --timeout TIMEOUT  minutes to wait for the folder before giving up with exit
                     6 (default 60)
  --cancel           cancel build N of SHIFT
